overview: This one-page cross-reference sheet records a communication sent from Taihoku by Ketcham on April 21, 1933, concerning mineral production in Taiwan during 1931. It indicates that the communication transmitted a Bureau of Mines questionnaire requesting a report on the subject and directs the reader to file 800.63/971 for the referenced document.

people.name: Ketcham
people.role: Sender of the referenced communication from Taihoku

subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet for report on mineral production in Taiwan
subfiles.about: The sheet refers readers to another file for a communication transmitting a Bureau of Mines questionnaire on Taiwan’s mineral production in 1931.
subfiles.summary: This filing note identifies an April 21, 1933 communication from Ketcham in Taihoku regarding mineral production in Taiwan for 1931. The referenced communication transmitted a Bureau of Mines questionnaire specifying the desired report. The note directs the reader to file 800.63/971, apparently for document number 59.

interest: The sheet is useful as evidence of how State Department records concerning Taiwan’s mining economy were indexed and cross-filed. It also documents a U.S. Bureau of Mines effort to gather standardized information on Taiwan’s 1931 mineral output, although the substantive questionnaire and report are not present here. The coexistence of the names Formosa, Taiwan, and Taihoku is valuable for tracing changing geographic terminology in archival catalogues.
